mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_member (team_id, user_id, user_name, role, join_time) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{role}, #{joinTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE team_member SET role = #{role} WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM team_member WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND user_id = #{userId}
